commit.subject: LU-20548 obd: show 'network' server mount option
commit.message:
LU-20548 obd: show 'network' server mount option

The 'network=' server mount option was added by LU-18637, but
server_show_options() does not include it in the reported mount options.
As a result, /proc/mounts and userspace commands such as mount and
findmnt omit the option even though it is applied.

Report lmd_nidnet from server_show_options().

Assisted-By: Codex 5.6-Sol
Fixes: cf9492e522ec ("LU-18637 obd: add 'network' server mount option")
Test-Parameters: env=ONLY=31 testlist=sanity-sec
Signed-off-by: Manish Regmi <mregmi@ddn.com>
Change-Id: Iea8d14f2cca36fb2d4f15624b814c5a62c257448
